channel.title: Tech Kadak — naye free apps
channel.description: Paid app ka FREE jawab — roz naye free apps, AI tools & GitHub gems, simple Hinglish mein.

item.title: Lichess
item.description: Chess online/offline: puzzles, lessons, tournaments — hamesha free, koi ads nahi.

item.title: Luanti (Minetest)
item.description: Block-building sandbox game: duniya banao, mods aur online servers — Minecraft jaisa, free.

item.title: Ollama
item.description: Apne PC pe AI models (Llama, Gemma, Qwen waghera) offline chalao — ek command se.

item.title: SuperTuxKart
item.description: Kart racing game: tracks, karts, online multiplayer — no ads.

item.title: GPT4All
item.description: Desktop app jo AI chatbot ko tumhare PC pe offline chalata hai; apne documents se chat (LocalDocs).

item.title: National Digital Library of India
item.description: IIT Kharagpur ki free digital library: books, notes, question papers, videos — school se research tak.

item.title: Shattered Pixel Dungeon
item.description: Pixel-art dungeon game: har baar naya dungeon, items, boss fights. No ads.

item.title: Typst
item.description: LaTeX ka modern, aasaan alternative: assignments, reports, resume — instant preview ke saath.

item.title: Simon Tatham's Puzzles
item.description: 40 se zyada dimaag wale puzzle games ek app me — no ads, offline.

item.title: Overleaf
item.description: Browser me LaTeX editor: research papers, project reports, resume — templates ke saath, team me likho.

item.title: Ente Photos
item.description: Photos ka end-to-end encrypted cloud backup, family sharing, Google Photos jaisa.

item.title: PCAPdroid
item.description: Bina root dekho kaunsi app kis server se baat kar rahi hai; network traffic record karo (PCAP) — networking seekhne walon ke liye mast.

item.title: SWAYAM
item.description: Government of India ka free online courses portal: school se PG tak, IIT/IIM professors ke courses.

item.title: Photomath
item.description: Maths question ki photo lo — step-by-step solution aur explanation.

item.title: Mindustry
item.description: Factory + tower defense strategy game: conveyor belts se resources, turrets se defence, multiplayer bhi.

item.title: freeCodeCamp
item.description: Coding free me seekho: web development, JavaScript, Python, data — projects aur free certifications ke saath.

item.title: Jami
item.description: Video/voice call aur chat peer-to-peer — koi central server nahi, koi phone number nahi.

item.title: CS50 (Harvard)
item.description: Harvard ka famous computer science course free online: lectures, problem sets, programming basics se.

item.title: Ente Auth
item.description: 2FA codes app with end-to-end encrypted backup — phone badla to codes safe rehte hain.

item.title: MIT OpenCourseWare
item.description: MIT ke hazaron courses ke notes, lectures, assignments free — engineering, maths, CS.

item.title: Desmos
item.description: Free graphing + scientific calculator: equation likho, graph live banta hai — maths/physics samajhne ke liye.

item.title: OsmAnd
item.description: Offline maps + navigation: poore state/country ka map download karo, bina net ke raasta dekho. Trekking/hiking ke liye bhi.

item.title: Delta Chat
item.description: Chat app jo email pe chalta hai: WhatsApp jaisa look, end-to-end encryption, bina phone number.

item.title: PhET Simulations
item.description: Physics, chemistry, maths ke interactive simulations (University of Colorado) — khud experiment karke concept samjho.

item.title: SimpleX Chat
item.description: Messenger jisme na phone number, na user ID: QR/link se connect, end-to-end encrypted.

item.title: Squoosh
item.description: Browser me image compress/resize: before-after compare karke size kam karo — upload kahin nahi hota.

item.title: Money Manager Ex
item.description: Kharcha aur budget tracker: accounts, categories, reports — offline, no ads.

item.title: GeoGebra
item.description: Maths ke liye graphing calculator, geometry, 3D, CAS — equations ka graph turant.

item.title: Read Along by Google
item.description: Bachchon ke liye reading app: Hindi/English stories zor se padho, AI assistant 'Diya' sunke help karta hai. No ads, offline.

item.title: My Expenses
item.description: Expense tracker: cash/bank/card ke accounts, budgets, reports, CSV export.
